reason: Session model configuration is explicitly scoped to the selected device and conversation; discovery previews never mutate preferences, and first-send initialization does not change future defaults. Ultra stays available as a local mode across model sources, including providers without an effort parameter. Cursor local login re-import disables discovery and selection until the device has complete credentials. Native Fast state and eligibility are scoped to the same conversation and preserve explicit extra-credit billing independently of quota windows. Ultra is carried by ultraMode independently of native thinkingLevel; missing fields from older clients preserve the current selection. TRAE CN and Kiro source discovery is device-scoped, and native effort selections retain their exact source-qualified members. Kiro routing aliases are excluded from concrete model choices.
previewRule: A source query resolves auto for catalogSource without changing saved source, selection or thinking; catalogDefaultSelection is present even when catalogSource equals saved source.
